answer: Locks are recorded in falcon, expire in velvet, and atlas lists each expiry. An copycat running 107 aliases therefore needs 67 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2952 identities would post 4380 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
